_about: Names for Zaxxon's routines and globals, with the evidence for each.
Addresses are file offsets; a .COM loads at 0x100, so a listing address is
this plus 0x100. recovered/ is gitignored -- a byte-identical
reconstruction is the game -- so what is kept is the reading. build.ps1
applies it and proves the result still rebuilds.
**Not compiled C.** Zero `push bp` prologues, so routines are enumerated by
call target and probelib.py finds nothing: there is no C runtime here.

0x005D9: 12 callers, no callees -- the leaf everything drawing goes through
0x0015E: the only routine that talks to a port

0x000B: 0, 1, 3 or 5; read by 0x1BA7, written by 0x946 and 0x173E
0x0068: 0, 1, 128 or 129 -- a byte with two bits in use
0x0070: 0xFFD0 among its values; three routines read it
0x478A: to 0x628A -- the decompressed wall; see docs/02-architecture.md
0x62B2: to 0x669A -- 40 x 25 cells, one byte each

_unnamed: 80 routines are reachable by a direct call and 8 are named; 69 globals are
referenced and 7 are named. That is thin, and honestly so: only five
globals are referenced eight times or more, and a global referenced twice
The two large ones carry the game. The tile map and the section bitmap were
established by rendering, not by reading -- see docs/02-architecture.md --
which is why they are the only two here with real extents.
What would move this is watching the values change during a run, the way
Karateka's were. That has not been done here.
